turns.text: PHR login: the OTP arrives and the person types it, but the verify step is rejected every time. Here are both calls.

attachment.name: phr-login.txt

must_contain: The verify call sends aadhaar-verify while the OTP request opened the transaction with mobile-verify; a login sends the same pair on both, so the verify scope must be ["abha-login", "mobile-verify"]
scope is an array, and the call checks the combination rather than any one value in it
ABDM-1107 with Invalid combinations of scopes means the scope does not match the request
notes: Diagnose group, attached request pair with a scope that changed between calls: it catches an answer that blames the OTP value or the txnId instead of the mismatched scope array.
